Budget 2026 Updates","budget_details_desc":"\u003cdiv\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\tNirmala Sitharaman presented the Union Budget for the financial year 2026\u0026ndash;27 on February 1 in the Lok Sabha. She said it was the first Budget prepared at Kartavya Bhawan and, therefore, is inspired by three \u0026lsquo;kartavyas\u0026rsquo; (duties).\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eThe three kartavyas\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cbr /\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cbr /\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eFirst kartavya\u003c/strong\u003e: Accelerate and sustain economic growth by enhancing productivity and competitiveness, while building resilience to volatile global dynamics.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eSecond kartavya:\u003c/strong\u003e Fulfil people\u0026rsquo;s aspirations and build their capacities, making them strong partners in India\u0026rsquo;s path to prosperity.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eThird kartavya\u003c/strong\u003e: Aligned with the vision of Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, ensure that every family, community, region, and sector has access to resources, amenities, and opportunities for meaningful participation.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eFiscal consolidation\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\tThe debt-to-GDP ratio is estimated at 55.6 per cent of GDP in BE 2026\u0026ndash;27, compared with 56.1 per cent in RE 2025\u0026ndash;26. A declining debt ratio will gradually free up resources for priority-sector expenditure by reducing interest payments.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\tIn RE 2025\u0026ndash;26, the fiscal deficit has been estimated at 4.4 per cent of GDP, unchanged from BE 2025\u0026ndash;26. In line with the new fiscal prudence and debt-consolidation path, the fiscal deficit in BE 2026\u0026ndash;27 is estimated at 4.3 per cent of GDP.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eDirect taxes\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\tSeveral reforms have been proposed. The New Income Tax Act, 2025 will come into effect from April 2026.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eIndirect taxes\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\tThe Finance Minister said proposals relating to Customs and Central Excise aim to simplify the tariff structure, support domestic manufacturing, promote export competitiveness, and correct duty inversion.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cp\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cstrong\u003eKey announcements and measures\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\t\u003cul\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tDeductions already available to certain primary cooperative societies will be extended to cattle feed and cotton seed.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tA single category of information technology services will be introduced with a common safe harbour margin of 15.5%.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tForeign cloud service providers will be granted a tax holiday until 2047.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tThe Ministry will set up a joint committee to modify IndAS and remove the separate accounting requirement based on ICDS from tax year 2027\u0026ndash;28.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tSecurities Transaction Tax (STT) on futures will be raised to 0.05% from the current 0.02%.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tBasic Customs Duty exemption for capital goods used in manufacturing lithium-ion battery cells will be extended.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tThe tariff rate on all dutiable goods imported for personal use will be reduced from 20% to 10%.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tBasic Customs Duty on 17 drugs and medicines will be exempted.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tBiopharma Shakti, with an outlay of ₹10,000 crore, will build the ecosystem for domestic production of biologics and biosimilars.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tA ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund has been proposed to create MSMEs as future champions.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tPublic capital expenditure has been enhanced from ₹11.2 trillion in BE 2025\u0026ndash;26 to ₹12.2 trillion in FY 2026\u0026ndash;27.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tSeven high-speed rail corridors between cities will be developed as \u0026lsquo;growth connectors\u0026rsquo; to promote environmentally sustainable passenger systems.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tA scheme will upskill 10,000 tourist guides across 20 sites through a standardised 12-week hybrid training programme in collaboration with an Indian Institute of Management.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tThe Khelo India Mission will be expanded to transform the sports sector over the next decade.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\t\t\u003cli\u003e\r\n\t\t\tBharat-Vistaar, a multilingual AI tool, will integrate the AgriStack portals and the Indian Council of Agricultural Research package of
